description: Li ion diffusion coefficient D(T), activation energy Ea, and Nernst-Einstein conductivity σ from AIMD-MLIP at multiple temperatures.

method_notes.aimd_mlip: Born-Oppenheimer MD with foundation MLIP (UMA-s-1p1, task=omat) on DFT-relaxed V0 structure. Langevin NVT thermostat, 2 fs timestep, equilibrate 10 ps + production 100 ps per T. Trajectory saved every 100 fs.
method_notes.msd_fit: Linear regression MSD = 6 D t in the diffusive regime (2-50 ps).
method_notes.arrhenius: ln(D) = ln(D0) - Ea/(kB T) fit across all measured T.
method_notes.nernst_einstein: σ_NE = n_Li z² e² D / (kB T), assuming Haven ratio H_R = 1 (uncorrelated motion). Real σ is typically σ_NE × H_R^-1 with H_R ≈ 0.3-0.7 for SE.
method_notes.caveats: Foundation MLIP (UMA-s-1p1) tends to overestimate Li transport by 3-5× vs experiment for LPSCl family. Ea is more robust than absolute σ. 300 K extrapolation from 600-1000 K Arrhenius has additional uncertainty if non-Arrhenius behavior exists near room T (rare for LPSCl).

results.method: UMA-s-1p1 (task=omat) AIMD, Langevin NVT 600/800/1000 K, 100 ps prod each

diffusion_per_T._note: Cl/P/S diffusion ~ 5x lower than Li → framework immobile, Li-only conductor ✓

arrhenius_fit.sigma_NE_300K_Scm_estimate: ~14e-3 (= 14 mS/cm) using n_Li ≈ 2.22e22 cm⁻³ from V0

vs_experiment.sigma_overestimate_attribution: Foundation MLIP overshoot of transport (typical) + Haven ratio = 1 assumption (real H_R ≈ 0.3-0.7 reduces σ by ~2×)

results.method: UMA-s-1p1 (task=omat) AIMD, Langevin NVT 600/800/1000 K, equilib 10 ps + prod 100 ps each, timestep 2 fs, 1000 frames. EXACT same protocol as modelc_v3.
results.v0_source: comp1_v3 V0_5fu.xyz (5 f.u. supercell, 65 atoms, 30 Li)

arrhenius_fit._window_dependence_WARNING: Ea depends strongly on MSD fit window because statistics are marginal (3 T points, T=800 K D anomalously low). Report with uncertainty; not yet paper-grade.

results.framework_immobile_check: D(Cl,P,S) ~ 6-9e-8 cm²/s ≈ 1/40-1/60 of D(Li) → framework rigid, Li-only conductor ✓ (same as modelc)

robust_findings.D_Li_600K: modelc 7.90e-6 vs comp1 3.73e-6 (2-20ps window) → modelc 2.1× faster. Window-robust (modelc 2-3× higher regardless of comp1 window).
robust_findings.sigma_NE_600K: modelc 0.543 vs comp1 0.273 S/cm → modelc 2.0× higher.
robust_findings.direction_matches_experiment: Halogen-rich/Li-deficient (modelc, LPSCl1.6) conducts ~2× better than stoichiometric (comp1, LPSCl). Matches expt: NEI/Ampcera Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 ~8.8 mS/cm vs Li6PS5Cl ~4.3 mS/cm = 2.05× ✓

mechanism_interpretation.Ea_similar_not_lower: comp1 Ea (0.16-0.22 eV) is SIMILAR TO or slightly BELOW modelc (0.224 eV) — NOT higher. The per-hop barrier is comparable in both.
mechanism_interpretation.conductivity_driven_by_prefactor: modelc's 2× higher σ comes from a higher prefactor D0 (modelc 5.75e-4 vs comp1 2.3e-4), i.e., MORE mobile carriers / accessible hops from the extra Li vacancies — not a lower migration barrier. Vacancy → more carriers, not easier hops.
mechanism_interpretation.caveat: Interpretation qualitative until comp1 statistics improved AND both systems re-fit with identical MSD window. modelc Ea=0.224 window not confirmed identical to comp1; needs consistent re-fit for paper.

todo_for_paper_grade: Re-fit BOTH comp1 and modelc D with identical MSD window (recommend 2-50 ps or block-averaged) on the container.
Improve comp1 statistics: T=800 K D is anomalously low (R²=0.77-0.87). Consider longer prod, more seeds, or 4-5 T points.
Apply Haven ratio for absolute σ comparison to experiment.
